title: The property manager changed the rent account
scenario: Your building manager emails that rent must go to a new bank account after a “payment processor migration.” The message includes your unit number and the manager’s usual signature.

answers.A: Send a small test payment first to make sure the account works.
answers.B: Confirm the new bank details through the tenant portal or a known phone number before changing your payment.
answers.C: Ask for the change to be posted in the formal tenant system or lease communication.

explanation: A test transfer proves only that the destination receives money. Payment-detail changes are a classic point for independent verification.
proTip: Verify the owner of the account, not its ability to receive money.
